title: FizzBuzz
summary: Checking the combined case first, and joining with commas.

say.never: 15 can be divided by 3 *and* by 5. If you test for 3 first, 15 says "Fizz" and never reaches "FizzBuzz". So always check the **combined** case (15) first, then the single ones.
say.bit: 15 is divisible by 3 **and** 5. If you test 3 first, it says Fizz and never reaches FizzBuzz.

say.never: You want commas *between* items but not after the last one. The trick: add `", "` before every item *except the first* (`if (i > 1)`). Then nothing is left dangling at the end.
say.bit: Add `", "` **before** every item except the first, so nothing trails at the end.
